_note: Say it like a native – reaction cards (docs/SAY-NATIVE.md). Source of truth for the web cards (#/say) and the teach2d 'react' videos. Every `key` is a lexicon headword (IPA + English meaning from the audited bank); meanings in 15 languages come from meanings.json (hand-checked, sense-correct – web/packs idiom glosses are literal and are NOT used). reg = polite | neutral | casual (the taught line is never rude); `dont` = a blunt/rude line taught only as 'don't say X, say Y', always masked on screen and never voiced. pose = the teacher's reaction clip (web/teach/characters.json clips).
